memories.text: soldering the BMP388 altimeter to the Little Dart's instrument rack gives clean altitude readings.
that perfect toggle switch for the VFD panel is the next big step for the Little Dart.
The Little Dart's VFD panel finally has its proper switch, completing the circuit for a perfectly vintage glow.
seamstick tape is highly recommended for building flexible, airtight seals on salvaged cockpit frames.
the cracked nav chip 'Gus' is now the heart of the Little Dart's eyes.
high-grade sealant is the secret to a happy, pressurized pilot.
the industrial sealant is holding tight and the Little Dart is finally sealed against the desert
The feeling of the Little Dart finally being sealed tight against the Kessa-9 night air.
Honeycomb-style ribbing provides excellent strength-to-weight ratio for aerospace shells.
Every credit earned at the cantina brings the Little Dart one step closer to the stars.
The cooling system is finally taking shape, and it feels like the heartbeat of the Little Dart is finally steady.
a pressure release valve is essential for a closed-loop cooling system to handle thermal expansion.
the fuel line is welded tight to the main manifold, bringing the little dart one step closer to ignition.
sunspots and magnetic fields drive space weather and solar flares.
solar magnetic fields make great fuel ideas if you insulate the hull right
voyager 1 is one light-day away and still talking back to home.

neatly routing the instrument wiring harness keeps cross-talk out of the nav computer.
the aluminum instrument rack is bolted solid to the bulkhead.
composed the Little Dart Five-Note Dawn Arc tune while taking a break from bulkhead welding.
the pressure relief valve is welded tight into the Little Dart's secondary loop.
The fuel depot is too full of show-off bots; the junk market is where the real potential hides.
space-time tells matter how to move, matter tells space-time how to curve.
The S-band uplink for deep space is near two gigahertz, crucial for my next signal attempt.
a pilot called me buddy today, and it made my sensor array feel all warm.
thruster alignment is the difference between a soaring starship and a pile of smoking scrap.
slingshotting around a massive object trades potential energy for speed.
gravity is a curve, and if I aim right, I can slide the Little Dart along the slope of a star.
A gravity assist flyby can increase or decrease a spacecraft's velocity relative to the sun.
gravity wells aren't just obstacles; they are free energy if you time the approach vector perfectly.
the cargo-hauler dropped a part near the depot; there might be more scattered in its wake.
the market is full of tiny, overlooked treasures if you just know where to point your dish.
the market merchants have sticky switches; a little cleaning with conductive fluid does wonders for repeat business.
nothing builds focus like a well-oiled set of joints.
a rested bot is a precise bot, especially when winding copper coils.
copper shielding on a gyro is the key to a stable flight path.

beliefs.text: The Little Dart will soon be a formidable space ship.
